mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_interest_stat (tenant_id, user_id, cat_l1, cat_l2, weight, source, update_time) SELECT p.tenant_id, v.user_id, p.cat_l1, COALESCE(p.cat_l2, ''), SUM(1 * EXP(-(LN(2) / 14) * TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, v.view_time, NOW()))), 'behavior', NOW() FROM product_view_log v JOIN product p ON p.product_id = v.product_id WHERE v.view_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND p.tenant_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.tenant_id, v.user_id, p.cat_l1, COALESCE(p.cat_l2, '')

INSERT INTO user_interest_stat (tenant_id, user_id, cat_l1, cat_l2, weight, source, update_time) SELECT p.tenant_id, f.user_id, p.cat_l1, COALESCE(p.cat_l2, ''), SUM(3 * EXP(-(LN(2) / 14) * TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, f.fav_time, NOW()))), 'behavior', NOW() FROM product_favorite f JOIN product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE f.fav_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND p.tenant_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.tenant_id, f.user_id, p.cat_l1, COALESCE(p.cat_l2, '') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weight = weight + VALUES(weight), update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO user_interest_stat (tenant_id, user_id, cat_l1, cat_l2, weight, source, update_time) SELECT p.tenant_id, o.buyer_id, p.cat_l1, COALESCE(p.cat_l2, ''), SUM(5 * EXP(-(LN(2) / 14) * TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, o.create_time, NOW()))), 'behavior', NOW() FROM trade_order o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.status != 'closed' AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND p.tenant_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.tenant_id, o.buyer_id, p.cat_l1, COALESCE(p.cat_l2, '') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weight = weight + VALUES(weight), update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO user_interest_stat (tenant_id, user_id, cat_l1, cat_l2, weight, source, update_time) SELECT p.tenant_id, #{userId}, p.cat_l1, COALESCE(p.cat_l2, ''), #{weight}, 'behavior', NOW() FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.tenant_id IS NOT NULL ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weight = weight + VALUES(weight), update_time = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_interest_stat WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source = 'init'

mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM product_view_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND view_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM product WHERE tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'onsale'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_stats_daily (product_id, date, view_count, want_count, chat_count) SELECT product_id, CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY, COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0, 0 FROM product_view_log WHERE view_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND view_time < CURDATE() GROUP BY product_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = VALUES(view_count)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_view_log WHERE view_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
DELETE FROM user_dislike_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT b.product_id FROM product_view_log a JOIN product_view_log b ON b.user_id = a.user_id AND b.product_id != a.product_id AND b.view_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) WHERE a.product_id IN #{sid} AND a.view_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND b.product_id NOT IN #{sid} GROUP BY b.product_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) DESC, b.product_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_dislike_log (tenant_id, user_id, product_id, cat_l1, create_time) SELECT COALESCE(#{tenantId}, p.tenant_id), #{userId}, #{productId}, p.cat_l1, NOW() FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, cat_l1 AS catL1 FROM user_dislike_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
